Tether Agent: a personal AI agent

Usage:
  tether <command> [flags]

Start here:
  setup       Run the setup wizard: provider, Telegram, host programs, systemd.
  doctor      Check the install. Each line shows ✓, ⚠, or ✗ and the next action.

Run the agent:
  chat        Start the interactive chat in this terminal.
  gateway     Run the Telegram channel and the cron scheduler.

Manage data:
  sessions    List the sessions, or export one as JSONL.
  skills      List the skills, or restore a bootstrap skill.
  pairing     Approve or revoke the Telegram users.
  usage       Show the calls, the tokens, and the cost of each model.
  backup      Save the state to one archive, without the secrets.
  restore     Put an archive from tether backup back into the data folder.

Maintain:
  update      Replace this binary with the newest release from GitHub.
  version     Print the version.
  help        Print this help, or the help of one command.

Flags for most commands:
  --data-dir DIR    The data folder. The default is TETHER_HOME, then ~/.tether.

Data folder (/home/you/.tether):
  config.yaml       The settings. See docs/CONFIG.md.
  .env              The API keys and the bot token.
  state.db          The sessions, the messages, and the usage.
  logs/tether.log   The log of chat and gateway.
  backups/          The archives of tether backup.

Environment:
  TETHER_HOME       The data folder, when --data-dir is not set.
  TETHER_PPROF      A loopback address for net/http/pprof in the gateway.

Run "tether help <command>" or "tether <command> --help" for the flags
of a command.
Docs: https://github.com/dnwandana/tether-agent
